Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 14 September 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, Buenavista, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Calauag, Lopez, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Plaridel, Unisan, Agdangan, Pagbilao, Padre Burgos, Atimonan, Mauban, Tayabas, Lucena, Lucban, Sampaloc, Real) and Laguna(Majayjay, Luisiana, Cavinti, Lumban, Paete, Pangil, Pakil, Kalayaan, Pagsanjan, Magdalena, Santa Cruz, Siniloan, Famy).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Rizal, Batangas, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Cavite and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon, Laur, Palayan, Penaranda, Gapan) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Infanta, Burdeos, Jomalig, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo) and Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Cabuyao, Calauan, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Liliw, Los Banos, Nagcarlan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Victoria, Binan, San Pedro, Mabitac, Santa Maria) which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text:
It’s heartening to see anti-corruption rally signs on display during weekend protests in Metro Manila. That said, some of the messages, make you do a double take: “Resign BBM, resign Sara Duterte, resign Speaker Romualdez…” It’s beginning to look like a messy jumble of ideas, so much so that the original message gets lost.

If the goal is truly anti-corruption, stick to that. Don’t dilute the cause by targeting even those who sparked the movement or who might otherwise be considered allies. Straying from the core message risks turning a meaningful effort into confusion and could undermine the entire movement.

data.raw_text:
Major Fire Hits Tondo, Manila, Philippines..

#Manila A major fire broke out on Saturday night, September 13, 2025, in Barangay 105, Happyland, Tondo, Manila, #Philippines. The blaze started at around 9:30 PM and quickly spread through the area.
The fire had been raised to Task Force Bravo, according to the Manila Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (DRRMO). Firefighting teams were on site conducting operations to contain the flames and prevent further damage.
Authorities have not yet confirmed the cause of the fire or the extent of property loss. No casualties have been reported as of this time.
